commits_data.title: Added ERF FlowID Hash Type inner bit
commits_data.message:
Added ERF FlowID Hash Type inner bit

The ERF record Flow ID extension header Hash Type field has been split in two:
 - The MSB indicates the FlowID Hash is calculated over a tunnel inner tuple.
 - The low 7 bits indicate the Hash Type as before.


(cherry picked from commit 44c2af8d62ced8cdcca4b23db61a0f491410643e)
